# FDG8007

> DO provide settable properties for optional arguments.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.2 Attributes.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: draft

Not machine-checkable: which arguments of an attribute are optional is a design decision. CA1019 reports a settable property that matches a constructor parameter, which FDG8010 forbids.

## From the book

```csharp
public class NameAttribute : Attribute {
  ...
  public int Age { get{..} set{..} } // optional argument
}
```
